pairs.why: Nearly identical boxes, but B has a slightly softer satin finish and a small gold emblem on the lid, closer to the lightly detailed real cards than A's plainer, flatter lid.
B's lid with its small emblem and gentler light falloff reads a bit more like the real cards, while A is plainer and more matte, like a placeholder.
Both are the same smooth, evenly lit striped box with no detail to choose between, and B's taller shape is neither better nor worse built.
A's taller, narrower drum looks slightly stretched, while B has believable hatbox proportions and the same soft satin finish as the real cards.
The two drawings differ only by a few pixels in lid size and handle placement, with the same finish, color and light.
A's thinner, smoother rope and plainer lid look a little more generic, while B's chunkier twisted rope and lid emblem match the real cards' readable detail better.
Barely different, but B's slightly fuller rope and the small emblem on the lid edge it ahead of A's plain lid.
A's lid and body are slightly squat and oversized, while B is better proportioned and has a little lid detail, closer to the real cards' look.
